column1: # The Archipelago tier. Modules that skip themselves when AP is not importable
# are correct locally and a silent hole in CI, so CI asserts they ran.
# When a PR adds an AP-dependent module, it adds its `no_skip_module` row here.
# These tests exercise reviewed local binaries or installed-game source that
# the Linux AP runner deliberately does not carry.  Each allowance names one
# exact test; any other skip remains a gate failure, and AP-required modules
# below must still skip zero tests.
# #205's option wiring only exists when Archipelago is importable, so the AP
# tier asserts this module ran all of it rather than skipping the option tests.
